import java.util.Scanner;
import java.io.*;
public class B{
	public static void main(String [] args) throws IOException{
		FI k = new FI(System.in);
		PrintWriter z = new PrintWriter(System.out);
		while(k.hasNext()){
			int n = k.nextInt();
			String s = k.next();
			boolean ok = false;
			int one = 0;
			String tt = "";
			String twoans = "";
			boolean wordnok = true;
			for(int c = 0;c<n;c++){
				char ch = s.charAt(c);
				if(ch == '('){
					ok = true;
					wordnok = true;
					tt = "";
				}
				else if(ch == ')'){
					tt = "";
					ok = false;
				}
				else{
					if(ok == false){
						if(ch == '_'){
							tt = "";
						}
						else{
							tt += ch;
						}
						if(tt.length()>twoans.length()){
							twoans = tt;
						}
					}
					else{
						if(ch == '_'){
							wordnok = true;
						}
						else{
							if(wordnok){
								one++;
								wordnok = false;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			z.println(twoans.length()+" "+one);
		}
		z.flush();
	}
	public static class FI {
	    BufferedReader br;
	    StringTokenizer st;

	    public FI(InputStream stream){
	        br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(stream));
	    }

	    public String next() {
	        return nextToken();
	    }
	    
	    public boolean hasNext(){
	    	try {
				return br.ready();
			} catch (IOException e) {
				e.printStackTrace();
			}
			return false;
	    }

	    public String nextToken() {
	        while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
	            String line = null;
	            try {
	                line = br.readLine();
	            } catch (IOException e) {
	                throw new RuntimeException(e);
	            }
	            if (line == null) {
	                return null;
	            }
	            st = new StringTokenizer(line);
	        }
	        return st.nextToken();
	    }

	    public int nextInt() {
	        return Integer.parseInt(nextToken());
	    }
	    
	    public long nextLong() {
	        return Long.valueOf(nextToken());
	    }

	}
	
	public static class FO extends PrintWriter {
        FO() { super(new BufferedOutputStream(System.out)); }
    }
}
